title: Clause-level precision for review-jev-rules: a process step inside a code rule is not checked against code

AC1.note: preClassifyProcessClause (src/review/conform-clauses.ts) wired into extractReferenceClauses; test 'PR #712's own false positive ... is pre-classified process, no Jev question built' (conform-clauses.test.ts) proves api-contracts.mdc's 'Review the contract for breaking changes' clause gets explicit.not_checkable_reason and buildClauseTagQuestions returns {} for the whole fenced block.

AC2.note: test.each 'code-property clause stays a Jev candidate' (6 cases: must+function/handler/import/class/query/type) all assert preClassifyProcessClause returns undefined, i.e. buildClauseTagQuestions still produces a question for them.

AC3.note: PROCESS_VERB_LEAD_TERMS/CODE_PROPERTY_NOUNS exported and documented with comments in conform-clauses.ts; 9 process-verb-lead true positives + 6 code-property true negatives + 4 isWorkflowListStep cases + 1 fenced-workflow full-doc test + 1 explicit-marker-wins test = 21 tests total for the pre-classifier.

AC4.note: buildClauseTagQuestions instructions rewritten (conform-clauses.ts) to say 'a property you can see in a code hunk' for hunk and 'an action someone performs' for not-checkable. Test 'the choice question distinguishes a code-hunk property from a human action' asserts both phrases appear verbatim.

AC5.note: conform-tag-cache.ts: hashConformDocContent now folds 'clause-tag-schema:v2' into hashOriginContent's input instead of re-exporting it directly. Two new tests in conform-tag-cache.test.ts: hashConformDocContent(x) !== hashOriginContent(x), and a raw hashOriginContent(x) (simulated pre-bump hash) misses cachedTagsFor while hashConformDocContent(x) hits.

AC6.note: review conform's full existing suite (conform-clauses.test.ts, conform-jev.test.ts, conform-state.test.ts, conform-report.test.ts, conform-pr-port.test.ts, conform-tag-cache.test.ts, review-conform-cli.test.ts) passes with ZERO expectation changes — checked every conform fixture (invented-doctrine.md and CLI-inline docs) against the new verb/code-noun lists beforehand; all existing conform clauses already carry explicit [state:...]/[not-checkable:...] markers, so the pre-classifier never fires on them (explicit always wins first) and conform's own tagging is byte-for-byte unchanged. Documented in conform-clauses.ts's file header comment.

AC7.note: bun test src/review/conform-* src/review/jev-rules* src/commands/review-jev-rules* src/commands/review-conform*: 196 pass, 0 fail, 516 expect() calls (9 files). bun run typecheck (tsc --noEmit): clean. bun run lint (eslint .): clean.

AC8.note: Live run (bun ./src/cli.ts review jev-rules --pr 712 --rules .metaproject/rules --max-calls 60 --json, fresh .metaproject/data/review-jev-rules/ cache, env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY): droppedClauses lists core-principle-contract-before-code-2 ('Review the contract for breaking changes') with reason 'Pre-classified process: clause opens with the imperative verb "review"...' — never reaches a tagging or violation call. tokens: {jevCalls:57, taggingCalls:19, violationCalls:38}. findings: 0 (down from 2 FP before this fix).

AC9.note: PR #712 live re-measure: before 2 findings/0 TP -> after 0 findings/0 TP (nothing to hand-label; the 2 prior FPs are the pre-classified clause). PR #717 live re-measure (same setup, fresh cache): before 0 findings -> after 0 findings (unchanged, no regression). tokens PR712 {jevCalls:57,taggingCalls:19,violationCalls:38}; PR717 {jevCalls:74,taggingCalls:19,violationCalls:55}; combined 131 jevCalls (38 tagging + 93 violation), cost ~$0.011 total. Recorded in journal.md.

AC10.note: PR #732 opened (https://github.com/MrCipherSmith/keryx/pull/732) from feat/clause-tag-precision to main, not merged, CI pending. Commit a7e375ee contains only src/review/conform-clauses.ts, conform-clauses.test.ts, conform-tag-cache.ts, conform-tag-cache.test.ts, and this flow's own .metaproject/flows/337-*/ files — .metaproject/data/ regeneration from the post-commit hook (gdgraph/wiki artifacts) was reverted with git checkout before push, working tree clean.

tasks.title: Collect remaining context
tasks.dispositionReason: Read jev-rules.ts/conform-clauses.ts/conform-tag-cache.ts/jev-rules-cache.ts; confirmed the api-contracts.mdc fenced numbered workflow (steps 1-5) is the source of the PR #712 false positives; checked existing test fixtures for collision risk with the new verb list.

tasks.title: Implement per plan
tasks.dispositionReason: Added preClassifyProcessClause/isWorkflowListStep to conform-clauses.ts (wired into extractReferenceClauses before Jev question building), rewrote buildClauseTagQuestions instructions to distinguish 'a property you can see in a code hunk' from 'an action someone performs', and bumped the clause-tag cache schema version (v2) in conform-tag-cache.ts's hashConformDocContent.

tasks.title: Add/adjust tests and make them pass
tasks.dispositionReason: Added 17 new unit tests (pre-classifier true/false positives, workflow-step detection, question wording, cache schema-version invalidation). bun test src/review/conform-* src/review/jev-rules* src/commands/review-jev-rules* src/commands/review-conform*: 196 pass, 0 fail. bun run typecheck and bun run lint both clean.

tasks.dispositionReason: Self-reviewed diff (conform-clauses.ts/.test.ts, conform-tag-cache.ts/.test.ts), pushed feat/clause-tag-precision, opened PR #732 (not merged, CI pending) with before/after measurement table.
